slides.title: Residual CYP inhibition remains the constraint
bullets: Any isoform above 50% inhibition: {{PRJ0004:cyp.n_any_gt50}} articles.
Above 50%: CYP1A2 {{PRJ0004:cyp.n_gt50_CYP1A2}}; CYP2C9 {{PRJ0004:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2C9}}; CYP2C19 {{PRJ0004:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2C19}}.
CYP2D6 {{PRJ0004:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2D6}}; CYP3A4 {{PRJ0004:cyp.n_gt50_CYP3A4}}.
CYP3A4 is the most frequently flagged isoform.
slides.notes: Isoform counts overlap; do not sum them to obtain an article count. This screen is not a clinical interaction prediction.
